The filing underscores federal support for critical‑minerals supply chains and could re‑rate rare‑earth and defense suppliers. Lithium Argentina (LAR) closed its PPG joint venture and secured a $180 million strategic investment from Ganfeng. Project financing helps de‑risk battery‑grade lithium output amid fierce EV supply‑chain competition. Nebius Group (NBIS) closed a private offering of convertible senior notes raising roughly $5.75 billion. Large financing materially reshapes capital structure and investors will watch dilution terms and use of proceeds. Arbutus (ABUS) launched a US$230 million modified Dutch‑auction tender offer, pricing between US$5.00–US$5.75. Buybacks can tighten float and support near‑term share dynamics. The Metals Royalty Company (TMC) closed on an additional 1.0% Mesabi royalty and secured US$165 million in financing. Royalty financing provides capital to back portfolio royalties and signals ongoing investor appetite for streaming and royalty models. Energy, storage, crypto mining and balance‑sheet crypto TeraWulf (WULF) won Kentucky PSC approval for a 482 MW power agreement for its Justified Data campus. Long‑term capacity deals remain critical where power is the binding constraint for miners and compute hubs. BTC Digital (BTCT) said a 10MW Georgia cryptocurrency computing site is nearing deployment readiness. New deployments highlight continued North American mining buildout. Zerostack Corp. (ZSTK) reported cryptocurrency holdings with an aggregate market value of approximately $1.06 billion. Balance‑sheet crypto disclosures can swing valuation multiples for fintechs and crypto‑native platforms. Consumer, retail, digital collectibles and real estate deals Real and RE/MAX Holdings (REAX) announced completion of their business combination and followed with a $450 million share repurchase authorization. The combination plus the buyback is a clear capital‑allocation signal aimed at boosting EPS and shareholder returns. Orangekloud Technology (ORKT) agreed to acquire Orbis Technology Limited, operator of the VeVe digital collectibles platform. The acquisition widens consumer engagement in NFTs and digital goods, melding e‑commerce with collectible ecosystems. Urban Story Ventures (VENU) unveiled a $350 million retail and residential district in Bend alongside a separate $300 million amphitheater project. Large‑scale development can create long‑term cash flows for RE developers and local economies. Technology, AI infrastructure, robotics and quantum ZJK (ZJK) secured large‑volume purchase orders for AI infrastructure components. Order flow offers an early signal of enterprise AI capex strength for chip‑adjacent suppliers. Operational hardware is a milestone for cloud quantum services roadmaps and potential customer contracts. IonQ (IONQ) said Skyloom optical communications terminals now total 84 on‑orbit installations after the latest launch. Scaling space links matters for quantum networking and satellite comms strategies. Micropolis Robotics (MCRP) became a robotics and physical‑AI solutions provider to ADNOC. The partnership spotlights industrial automation demand in energy and logistics, and validates robotics-as-a-service in heavy‑industry rollouts. Index additions often prompt passive inflows and improved liquidity. Greenland Mines (GRML) delivered an S‑K 1300 resource estimate for Sarfartoq, including the project's first indicated resource for Nd‑Pr magnet rare earths. Resource milestones can accelerate project financing and buyer interest from magnet manufacturers. Silver Bow Mining (SBMT) agreed to acquire the Jefferson County Metallurgical Complex. M&A can lift margins through processing synergies and shorten concentrate‑to‑product timelines.
